drawings.description: schéma redressé : sur la page, une seule fois $\mathrm{C}_{\mathrm{aff}}(n)$, au bas d'une flèche verticale $\alpha$ issue de $\mathrm{C}_{\mathrm{aff}\,\mathrm{st}}(I_0)$ et d'une flèche oblique $\alpha^{!}$ partant de $\mathrm{C}^{!}_{\mathrm{aff}\,\mathrm{st}}(I_0)$ ; nous l'avons dédoublé pour ne pas faire se croiser les flèches. En marge, à droite, sous $\mathbb{D}_{I_0}$ : « (\ill{} automorphismes de la str.\ polygonale $I_0$) », qui glose $\mathbb{D}_{I_0}$ (son D ajouré, rendu $\mathbb{D}$, le groupe diédral). L'indice $\mathrm{st}$ de $\mathrm{C}^{!}_{\mathrm{aff}\,\mathrm{st}}(I_0)/\mathbb{D}_{I_0}$ est \uncertain{lu}
drawings.kind: arrow diagram
drawings.notes: As on the page (not redressed): the line D_{I_0} in S_{I_0} [in S_I] at the top; C^!_aff st(I_0) in C_aff st(I_0); the vertical arrow alpha from C_aff st(I_0) and the oblique arrow alpha^! from C^!_aff st(I_0) both end at C_aff(n), written once, = C^!_aff st(I_0)/D_{I_0}; the marginal gloss under D_{I_0} is only indicated (two short lines), not reproduced.

drawings.description: page de dessins au crayon, avec quelques calculs : une sphère parcourue de trois grands cercles (points d'intersection marqués) ; une pyramide et une bipyramide ; un réseau oblique de points marqués alternativement « $+$ » et « $\bullet$ » ; un octaèdre repassé à l'encre bleue, inscrit dans un cube au crayon, avec à côté un signe \uncertain{$\mathfrak{S}$} ; un cube quadrillé ; en bas à droite un polyèdre à faces carrées et hexagonales (un octaèdre tronqué ?) inscrit dans un cube ; en haut à droite un arbre ramifié à trois niveaux
drawings.kind: page of pencil drawings of polyhedra
drawings.notes: Whole page, re-read on four zoomed views; every solid drawn on vertices placed once. Sphere (top left): the contour, an equator and a meridian (three great circles), the five marked points computed as their crossings. Below it a pyramid over a bipyramid (pencil; the hidden back edge dashed). Top right the three-level tree, every branch starting at its node. Left: the oblique lattice of two rising and two descending lines, the points marked alternately + and dot at their four crossings. The octahedron retraced in ink (heavy): its five visible vertices and eight inked edges; the S-like sign beside it (uncertain in the transcription). Bottom left the cube with grid lines (pencil, schematic). Bottom right the polyhedron with square and hexagonal faces: its outline (nine vertices) and the inked inner edges, the two dotted hidden edges. Revised 2026-11-09 after Michel's check (#136: « still approximate, you are missing some grey pencil lines »), from fresh crops of p. 11 (one with the blue ink told apart from the grey pencil): the grey pencil lines are added, in pencil grey. Octahedron: the pencil cube round it and its pencil inner edges (seventeen strokes, among them the heavy pencil strokes from the top face down to the lower left edge and to the bottom vertex); the blue-inked octahedron is unchanged. Truncated polyhedron at the bottom right: the pencil cube round it (outer and inner squares, the corner diagonals) and the pencil edges of its back half (the vertical down to the hidden vertex and the edges leaving it). The cube with grid lines is redrawn stroke by stroke instead of schematically (twenty-one strokes, the three heavy ones thick). Sphere: the doubled stroke of the meridian, the second arc in its lower right half and the doubling of the contour at the right. Pyramid over bipyramid: the doubled left edge, the short vertical at the left, and the two dashed hidden edges down to the bottom vertex. The lattice: the faint second rising stroke at the lower left. The tree: the small strokes at the tips. Left out: the calculations (48 = 2.4!, 5!/2.4!, 8x3x2 ...) and the scribble before « 3x2x3 ». Still differs: in the dense middle of the octahedron and of the grid cube, which pencil stroke joins which is a reading; to check again.

drawings.description: grande figure occupant le haut et le milieu de la page : dans un cercle au crayon, un arrangement de neuf pseudo-droites, six droites $\Delta_A$, $\Delta_{A'}$, $\Delta_B$, $\Delta_{B'}$, $\Delta_C$, $\Delta_{C'}$ (deux à deux concourantes en trois points marqués près du bord) et trois courbes $D_A$, $D_B$, $D_C$ qui passent par le centre ; les extrémités portent ces étiquettes, les régions leur nombre de côtés ($3$, $4$, $5$, et $3'$, $4'$, $5'$), les points du centre les lettres $A$, $B$, $C$, $A'$, $B'$, $C'$, $L$, $M$, $N$, $L'$, $M'$, $N'$, $P$, $Q$, $R$, $P'$, $Q'$, $R'$ ; trois arcs du bord sont épaissis, trois autres en tirets
drawings.kind: arrangement of nine pseudo-lines in a disc
drawings.notes: Whole-page ink figure. The six lines Delta are straight and are drawn through three computed points: Delta_A and Delta_A' meet at the marked point on the right, Delta_B and Delta_B' at the one on the left, Delta_C and Delta_C' at the one below (heavy dots; the letter written at each is overwritten and is not set). The hexagon A, B', C, A', B, C' at the centre is formed by these six lines, each vertex the crossing of two of them, all computed. D_A, D_B, D_C are smooth curves through the points read on the page; P', P (D_A on Delta_C, Delta_C'), Q, Q' (D_C on Delta_A', Delta_A), R, R' (D_B on Delta_B', Delta_B) are computed on the lines. The pencil circle is drawn as a true circle (on the page it is free-hand and visible in parts). Heavy rim arcs between Delta_C' and Delta_C (top), Delta_A and Delta_A' (left), Delta_B' and Delta_B (right); the opposite short arcs dashed or dotted, as on the page. Editorial device: the centre, where his labels are 1 to 2 mm apart, is repeated below the figure enlarged 3.5 times (dotted frames), and the labels of the centre are set only there. Still differs: inside the hexagon the three curves cross within a few millimetres under ink blots; their paths there (the small central triangle, and on which side of each hexagon vertex a curve passes) are a reading, so the cells at the centre are not certified against his count 7 + 24 + 6 = 37 regions (which is the count of a simple arrangement of nine pseudo-lines); three blots at the centre and the overwritten letters at the three outer points are left out. His labels 3/3', 4/4', 5/5' are placed as read. Redrawn 2026-11-12 (issue 128): to check again.

drawings.description: au-dessous de la grande figure, à gauche, deux petits hexagones de sommets $C'$, $A$, $B'$, $C$, $A'$, $B$ (dans cet ordre) : le premier, à diagonales épaisses, est entièrement couvert d'un gribouillis ; le second porte un trait épais du côté $C'A$ vers l'intérieur, prolongé au crayon vers $A'$, une diagonale au crayon de $C'$ à $C$, un trait de $B$ à $B'$ marqué de deux points, et un « $B$ » à l'intérieur
drawings.kind: hexagon with diagonals (a second one struck)
drawings.notes: Two ink hexagons. The upper one is scribbled over (struck) and is not drawn. The lower one: six vertices labelled C', A, B', C, A', B clockwise from the top left, sides heavy; a heavy stroke from the middle of side C'A to an inner point, continued in pencil towards A'; a pencil diagonal from C' through that inner point to C; a line from B to B' carrying two heavy dots; the letter B inside. Left out: the small stroke with a blot to the right of the hexagon. Still differs: the inner strokes are a reading of a small free-hand figure (which strokes are meant as the three long diagonals is not certain). Redrawn 2026-11-12 (issue 128): to check again.

drawings.description: en haut de la page, au crayon : cinq pseudo-droites en étoile, avec au centre un pentagone marqué $5$, entouré de cinq triangles marqués $3$ ; autour, cinq régions marquées $4_1$, $4_2$, $4_3$, $4_5$, $4_6$, les mêmes indices étant répétés aux extrémités opposées ; un court trait épais traverse le pentagone d'un sommet à l'autre ; au-dessus, à gauche, deux traits isolés
drawings.kind: arrangement of five pseudo-lines (pentagram)
drawings.notes: Pencil. Five pseudo-lines drawn as smooth curves through the ten crossing points, each point shared by the two curves that cross there. Central pentagon 5, five triangles 3, the regions 4_1, 4_2, 4_3, 4_5, 4_6 and the same labels repeated at the opposite ends (the same regions across infinity). The short heavy stroke across the pentagon and the two isolated strokes at the top left are drawn. Disagreement with the transcription's note: it counts six pseudo-lines and regions 4_1 to 4_6; the page has five long lines (the sixth stroke is the short one inside the pentagon) and no label 4_4: the label at the right end, read 4_6, is the region 4_6 seen across infinity. Redrawn 2026-11-12 (issue 128): to check again.
drawings.disagreement: The note says six pseudo-lines and regions 4_1 to 4_6: five lines and a short stroke are on the page, and no 4_4.

drawings.description: en haut de la carte, deux petites figures à l'encre : à gauche un carré, deux coins du haut marqués « $-1$ » et « $+1$ », recoupé par une diagonale épaisse, des traits en tirets et une droite oblique venue du haut à gauche, un point marqué sur son côté supérieur ; à droite un carré analogue, traversé d'une longue droite oblique épaisse et de plusieurs traits repassés
drawings.kind: two small sketches: squares cut by oblique lines
drawings.notes: Two free-hand ink sketches, redrawn stroke by stroke. Left: the square, an inner smaller square at its upper left, the dashed horizontal and vertical, the heavy diagonal from the left side, a pencil stroke parallel to it, the heavy dot on the top side with a heavy stroke to the right side, the long oblique line from the upper left (doubled) and short strokes beside it; the corner labels are read -1 and +1 (the transcription's note has two corners marked with a double prime). Right: the square, the long heavy oblique line through it, the dashed horizontal and vertical inside, several oblique strokes gone over, dashes at the upper left. Left out: faint pencil ovals over the right square. Still differs: both are overdrawn several times; the strokes are a reading and their ends are approximate. Redrawn 2026-11-12 (issue 128): to check again.

drawings.description: au bas de la carte, une construction d'un arrangement de droites : deux horizontales, deux verticales, deux obliques épaisses, deux droites au crayon et deux lignes en tirets ; sur la première horizontale les points $P$, $L$, $B$, $C'$, $N$, sur la seconde $N'$, $C$, $B'$, $L'$, $P'$ ; $A$, $A'$, $Q$, $Q'$, $M$, $M'$, $R$, $R'$ aux autres intersections ; les longueurs $a$, $b$ (en haut) et $a'$, $b'$ (en bas) marquées sur les segments
drawings.kind: construction of a line arrangement with named points
drawings.notes: Ten lines, every named point computed as the intersection of its lines and every line drawn through those points. Two horizontals (P, L, B, C', N on the first; N', C, B', L', P' on the second), two verticals (through B, A', N', R' and through R, N, A, B', M), the heavy oblique through M', C', A, L', the heavy steep line through Q, L, A', C, M, the pencil line R, C', C, R' (concurrent with the first horizontal and the heavy oblique at C'), the pencil line P, A', A towards P' (dashed on the left of A' as on the page), the dashed line B B', and the dashed arc from Q through Q' to B. P' lies off the right edge, at the meeting of the second horizontal and the line A' A; the label is set where he wrote it. Left out: an overwritten letter at the crossing of the two heavy obliques, above M'. Still differs: on the page the line A' A is interrupted between A and the right half; L and B are 0.3 mm apart, as on the page. Redrawn 2026-11-12 (issue 128): to check again.

drawings.description: feuille de dessins au stylo et au crayon : à gauche cinq droites $D_0$ (horizontale, épaissie), $D_1$, $D_2$, $D_3$, $D_4$ formant une étoile à cinq branches, les deux triangles inférieurs hachurés, de longs traits parallèles au crayon descendant sous l'étoile ; à droite de $D_0$, un « $D_0'$ » raturé ; plus à droite une courbe (pseudo-droite) descendant du haut vers le bas à droite ; à droite encore, quatre petits croquis de deux ou trois droites sécantes, un côté de chaque droite marqué de hachures
drawings.kind: pentagram of five lines D_0..D_4 with hatched triangles, a curve and four small sketches
drawings.notes: The five lines are drawn through the ten crossing points of the star, each point shared. D_0 heavy between D_1 and D_4 and beyond; D_2 bends down at its lower right end and D_3 is bent, as on the page. Hatching of the two lower triangles and of the tip above the top crossing is schematic (a few strokes each); five long pencil strokes below the star stand for the parallel strokes of the page. The curve on the right and the four small sketches (lines with hatching on one side) are redrawn stroke by stroke, their hatching schematic. Left out: the struck label D_0' at the right end of D_0 (strike-outs are not drawn) and faint pencil traces at the bottom of the sheet. Redrawn 2026-11-12 (issue 128): to check again.

drawings.description: dans la marge gauche, en regard du paragraphe barré, un petit croquis : un contour fermé (une sphère) et, à l'intérieur, deux arcs qui se coupent en deux points marqués, en haut et en bas, un troisième arc en tirets entre eux ; à gauche, un « ? »
drawings.kind: sphere with two arcs meeting at two antipodal points
drawings.notes: Ink. Closed outline; two arcs from the upper marked point to the lower one, forming an oval; a dashed arc between the same two points and a short dashed arc near the top right; the question mark at the left. The long stroke that crosses the sketch at the left is one of the strokes striking out the paragraph and is not drawn. Redrawn 2026-11-12 (issue 128): to check again.

drawings.description: en haut de la feuille, quatre dessins d'arrangements de droites, un double trait vertical après le premier : (1) quatre droites en position générale, avec « $4$ » et « $(\mathfrak{S}_4)$ » ; (2) cinq droites en position générale, « $(D_5)$ $5$ pos.\ générale » ; (3) cinq droites dont trois concourantes, « $5$ position particulière » ; (4) six droites, les côtés d'un triangle et trois droites issues des sommets concourantes en un point intérieur, quatre points marqués, « $6$ en position particulière »
drawings.kind: four small line arrangements (4, 5, 5 and 6 lines)
drawings.notes: Ink. (1) four lines in general position. (2) five lines in general position. (3) five lines, three of them through one computed point (the page shows them meeting at one point; this is the special position), one of the three heavy. (4) the three sides of a triangle and the three lines from its vertices through one interior point, all drawn through the four computed points, which are marked. The captions are set as he wrote them; the struck sign between (2) and (3) is not drawn. Redrawn 2026-11-12 (issue 128): to check again.

drawings.description: à droite de « (5) », un dessin : sept droites, quatre en trait plein (un quadrilatère complet, ses six sommets marqués) et trois en tirets (ses trois diagonales) ; un septième point est marqué à la rencontre de deux des diagonales

drawings.notes: Ink. Four solid lines, their six intersection points computed once and marked; the three diagonals dashed, each drawn through its two vertices; the meeting point of two diagonals at the lower right is marked as on the page (seven dots in all; the transcription's note counts six). The third diagonal point is not marked on the page. Redrawn 2026-11-12 (issue 128): to check again.

The complete quadrilateral with its diagonals in the middle of the page belongs to the text ("arrangement d'un quadrilatère et de ses diagonales") and has no mark; it is not drawn.

drawings.notes: A few lines bounding a facet; the vertices s (upper right) and s' (left) joined by a curve marked T; a horizontal line at the bottom marked J. The heavy dots at the line crossings are drawn; one line is thickened in two places.

drawings.notes: Five lines; two triple points marked heavy.

drawings.kind: two pencils of lines with distinct vertices
drawings.notes: Ink. Three lines through the upper vertex and two through the lower left vertex (heavy dot), each drawn through its vertex; a dashed line through the lower vertex, solid at its right end. Disagreement with the transcription's note (« la droite qui les joindrait en pointillé »): on the page the dashed line passes through the lower vertex only and crosses the three lines of the upper pencil well below their vertex. Redrawn 2026-11-12 (issue 128): to check again.

drawings.description: au-dessous de $\mathrm{IV}_7$, un dessin : sept droites, quatre en trait plein (un quadrilatère complet, ses six sommets marqués en noir) et trois en tirets (les diagonales) ; les trois points de rencontre des diagonales sont entourés d'un petit cercle, celui de droite étant de plus marqué en noir
drawings.kind: complete quadrilateral with its three diagonals, diagonal points ringed
drawings.notes: Ink. Four solid lines through the six marked vertices; three dashed diagonals, drawn as slightly curved lines through their two vertices and through the three diagonal points as placed on the page (he draws them free-hand; straight lines through the vertices would put the right-hand diagonal point further out). The three diagonal points are ringed, the right one also filled, as on the page (the transcription's note counts two ringed points). The solid end of the horizontal diagonal and the short solid stroke at the lower right are drawn. Redrawn 2026-11-12 (issue 128): to check again.

drawings.description: à gauche, un dessin : trois droites en position générale formant un triangle
drawings.kind: three lines in general position
drawings.notes: Ink. Three slightly curved lines through their three computed crossing points. Redrawn 2026-11-12 (issue 128): to check again.

drawings.description: à gauche du texte, un dessin : un heptagone aux côtés fléchés, sommets en pointillé, avec « $u_0(i) = i+1$ » et une flèche courbe au centre. « $d_i$ » est ajouté au-dessus de « bijection », « de $\vec{I}_i$ » est \uncertain{lu}. Au-dessus de « circulaire, i.e. transitive », une insertion : « (\ill{} par $i_\alpha = u_0^\alpha(i_0)$) ». « $\nu = \nu_s$ » est écrit dans la marge gauche, en face de (28)
drawings.kind: hexagon with arrowed sides and dotted external bisectors
drawings.notes: A hexagon. Six sides drawn as arrows going round counter-clockwise on the page: top to upper left, down the left, along the bottom, up to the right corner, up to the upper right corner, back to the top. The six corners are computed once as the meeting points of consecutive sides read on the page, and every side is drawn between them, so the hexagon closes exactly; its proportions are those of the page (a regular hexagon fitted to the six corners misses them, and the pairs of dots, by up to 6 mm, so it is not imposed). At each corner the external bisector is dotted: drawn outwards along the bisector of the corner's angle, it carries the pair of dots he set outside that corner. The two dotted marks on the top corner, just inside it, are drawn as two points; i under them, u_0(i) = i+1 at \small and the curved arrow at the centre as before. Revised 2026-11-09 after Michel's check (#132): Michel: the drawing is right (not a heptagon); « also two dotted marks on the top vertex; it should be a hexagon with the six external bisectors dotted ». Redrawn so: the hexagon closed at its six exact corners (the sides were cut short at three of them), the six external bisectors dotted, the two marks on the top corner.
drawings.disagreement: The transcription calls it a heptagon; the page has a hexagon (six arrowed sides, six corners, a pair of dots on the external bisector of each), confirmed by Michel (#132).

Les côtés sont marqués $a$ (de $s$ à $t$), $b$ (de $s$ à $u$) et $c$ (de $t$ à $u$ sur $\Delta$) ; les pieds sont $t_i = t$ et $t_j = u$
drawings.kind: triangle of pseudolines
drawings.notes: Two lines crossing at s at the top, D_i = D (left, arrowed downwards) and D_j = D' (right, with an arrow down beside it), cut by the horizontal Delta (arrowed to the right); sides a, b, c; feet t_i = t and t_j = u. The arrowhead of Delta and its label lie beyond the right edge of the crop.

drawings.description: figure : un triangle de sommets $s$, $s'$ (sur $\Theta$, horizontale, avec $\vec{a}$ fléchée de $s$ vers $s'$) et $t$ au sommet ; le côté $b$ de $s$ à $t$ et le côté $b'$ de $t$ à $s'$ sont fléchés dans le sens $s \to t \to s'$, plusieurs petites flèches le long de chacun. Une double flèche verticale, dans la marge, descend vers le texte qui suit
drawings.kind: oriented triangle of pseudolines
drawings.notes: Vertices s, s' on the horizontal Theta (a arrowed from s to s') and t at the top; the sides b (s to t) and b' (t to s') carry small arrows in the direction s -> t -> s'. In the margin below, the double arrow pointing down to the text.

drawings.description: figure, à gauche : six droites, les côtés du triangle $a$, $b$, $c$ et trois droites $D_a$, $D_b$, $D_c$ issues des sommets ; points marqués $a$, $b$, $c$, $a'$, $b'$, $c'$ à l'intérieur, $\alpha$, $\beta$, $\gamma$ sur les côtés. « $9$ » est écrit en marge devant « sommets ». Au-dessus de « répartissent », un indice \uncertain{$D_{J'}$} ; au-dessus de « la configuration est » biffé, « correspondant », \uncertain{lu}
drawings.kind: triangle with three lines from the vertices
drawings.notes: Six lines: the sides of the triangle with vertices a, b, c and the lines D_a, D_b, D_c through them; the points a', b', c' inside, alpha, beta, gamma on the sides (gamma looks like a small x). Labels as read on the crop.

drawings.description: à gauche, un dessin : six droites, les côtés d'un triangle de sommets $a$, $b$, $c$ (points noirs) et trois droites issues des sommets, concourantes en $d$ ; leurs pieds sur les côtés opposés sont marqués $\alpha$ (sur $bc$), $\beta$ (sur $ac$), $\gamma$ (sur $ab$)
drawings.kind: triangle with three concurrent cevians
drawings.notes: Ink. The three sides through the vertices a, b, c (heavy dots) and the three lines from the vertices through d, each drawn through its vertex, d and its computed foot; labels a, b, c, d, alpha, beta, gamma as on the page. The transcription's note speaks of medians and a sixth line: the six lines are the three sides and the three concurrent lines. Redrawn 2026-11-12 (issue 128): to check again.

drawings.description: dessin à l'encre : dix droites, deux verticales épaisses, deux horizontales et six obliques, avec cinq sommets quadruples marqués d'un point noir (les quatre coins du carré central et un point à l'intérieur) ; chaque région porte le nombre de ses côtés, $3$, $4$ ou $5$ (une seule région $5$, en bas au centre), les régions du haut « id »
drawings.kind: arrangement of ten lines with five quadruple points
drawings.notes: Ink. Ten lines: the two verticals and two horizontals of the central square, its two diagonals, and four lines each through one corner and the inner point; every line is drawn through its marked points, so that four lines meet exactly at each of the five dots. Which oblique passes through which dot was read on a 600 dpi crop and agrees with his count: ten lines with five quadruple points and fifteen simple crossings give 31 regions. Region labels 3, 4, 5 and « id » (the upper regions, the same as the lower ones across infinity) as on the page. Left out: a small overwritten digit beside the lower left dot; the heavy 3 at the left is written over an earlier digit. The transcription's note does not count the lines. Redrawn 2026-11-12 (issue 128): to check again.

drawings.description: dessin à l'encre : six droites, deux verticales, deux presque horizontales et deux obliques, les obliques passant par les coins opposés du petit carré central et se coupant en son centre ; les quatre triangles du carré et les quatre régions qui le bordent sont marqués $3$, les régions des coins $4$, celles du haut « id » ; à droite, cinq points isolés
drawings.kind: six lines: a square and its two diagonals
drawings.notes: Ink. Two verticals, two near-horizontals and two obliques; each oblique is drawn through two opposite corners of the central square (four triple points) and they cross at the computed centre. Labels 3 (eight), 4 (four) and « id » (four) as on the page: twelve regions. Five isolated dots at the right (the transcription's note counts four; the fifth is a blot with a short tail). drawings.description: à gauche, un dessin au crayon : deux droites $D$ et $D'$ issues d'un point $t$ (à gauche), une droite verticale $\Delta$ passant par $s$ (en bas), une droite $\Delta'$ issue de $s$ vers la gauche, une droite horizontale épaissie $\Gamma'$ et une droite oblique $\Gamma$ (en haut) ; les points $u$ (sur $D$) et $u'$ (sur $D'$) sont marqués sur la verticale
drawings.kind: pencil drawing of lines
drawings.notes: Faint pencil, every line straight and every named point the crossing of the lines drawn: t = D meet D' (left), u = D meet Delta and u' = D' meet Delta on the vertical, s = Delta meet Delta' (bottom, with the dot he put just above it drawn at the crossing); both D and D' run on past t to the left, Delta and Delta' run on past s; the horizontal Gamma' thickened in its middle (the thick stretch on the line); the oblique Gamma at the top, which passes close to u but not through it (the text asks Gamma, Gamma' not concurrent on D, D'). Labels t, u, u', s, Delta, Delta' at \small. Still differs: the labels D, D', Gamma, Gamma' are not legible (a mark above u and a heavy mark at the top right may be two of them) and are left out; which line is which follows the transcription. Redrawn 2026-11-09 (issue 128): to check again. Question settled by a machine pass on the facsimile, 2026-11-12 (page): at 450 dpi the oblique passes through u, the crossing of D and Delta, and carries the label Gamma at its upper right end (after an overwritten letter); the thickened horizontal passes through u', the crossing of D' and Delta, and is Gamma' by the text (« Gamma ... mais par u », « Gamma' ... mais par u' »); D, D' and Gamma' are not labelled on the page. Gamma is now drawn through u, Gamma' through u', and the label Gamma is set. Not checked by a reader.

drawings.kind: two oriented pseudolines cut by two lines
drawings.notes: From t (left): the oriented D (through u_1, u_2) and D' (through u'_1, u'_2), arrowheads on both; cut by Delta_1 and Delta_2 meeting at s at the bottom; a curved arrow from Delta_1 to Delta_2 near s. The small superscript of Delta_2 is drawn as on the page (unreadable mark, left out).
